concepts.def: Decisive Viet Minh victory over French forces under Giap; ended French Indochina, led to Geneva Accords.
Agreement partitioning Vietnam at 17th parallel pending elections; US blocked elections to prevent Ho Chi Minh victory.
Alleged North Vietnamese attack on USS Maddox; resolution gave Johnson power for full military involvement.
Viet Cong surprise attacks on 100 cities during lunar new year; military defeat but US public confidence collapsed.
US troops under Lt. Calley killed 504 unarmed civilians; cover-up exposed 1969, devastated US moral authority.
30 April capture by North Vietnamese; helicopter evacuations from US embassy ended American involvement.
